evidence: frontend/apps/reality-web/src/components/favorites/PriceAlerts.tsx:98 and :108 — catch blocks on authenticated mutations log the RAW rejection carrier via `console.error('Failed to mark price alert read:', err)` / `console.error('Failed to mark all price alerts read:', err)`, bypassing lib/safe-error.ts `toSafeLogMessage()`.

err originates from `markRead.mutateAsync(alertId)` / `markAllRead.mutateAsync()` (useMarkFavoriteAlertRead / useMarkAllFavoriteAlertsRead) — authenticated favorites mutations. lib/safe-error.ts documents that api-client fetch/axios rejections embed the originating request (config.data / request / response.config.data), so `console.error('…', error)` serializes secret-bearing request bodies + Authorization header to the console; toSafeLogMessage() exists specifically to extract only the message string and drop the carrier.

Convention is established and followed elsewhere: components/import/FeedImport.tsx:529, components/import/CrmConnection.tsx:409, components/agency/RealtorManagement.tsx:579 all correctly log `toSafeLogMessage(error)`. PriceAlerts.tsx (and components/comparison/ComparisonUrlHandler.tsx:64,:80, though that one is a public unauthenticated GET so lower risk) are the two sites that still log the raw object.

Severity: LOW (+1) as emitted — the leak surfaces only in the browser console AND only if the favorites reality-api-client attaches auth config/body to the thrown rejection (not confirmed statically). It rises to MEDIUM (+2, credential-leak) if that client does attach request config to rejections (plausible, matching safe-error.ts's stated rationale) and if console breadcrumbs are captured by any telemetry. Fix: wrap both err args in toSafeLogMessage(err). Cloud-verifiable (reality-web: biome + typecheck; a unit test asserting the logged string carries no `config`/`authorization` would satisfy IG3).
